# Neurochemical Recipe Book

*Written 2026-11-22. Generated by `neuro_recipes.py` (data, tests in `tests/test_neuro_recipes.py`). Sources are in `references/NeuroRecipes/` and `ContextPlease/claude/references/INDEX.md`.*

A recipe is the mix the Tone character carries: seven levels, one per chemical, in kite order and rainbow order. Level 0 is black, level 1 is white, and the pure hue sits at the baseline: brighter is warmer, darker is more negative. The seven together are the Emotional Spectrum of a word, and the same seven describe the user (read from the input) and Ptolemy (set by the dispenser).

**How the numbers were set.** The papers give the direction of each chemical on each state (arouses, inhibits, raised, lowered), not a magnitude. Every level is a five-step engineering setpoint (.1 .3 .5 .7 .9, with .05/.15/.95 at the extremes) chosen from those directions. Each recipe lists the sources that fix its directions and the test that moves its numbers; a test result sets the next revision.

## 1. The seven

| position | colour | chemical | silk (orbweaver name) | what it does to word choice and sentence build | emotion-linked sentences / papers in the 40-paper corpus |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| hub | red | OPI | SHELL | comfort, safety, "liking"; inhibits RAGE and GRIEF; the protective container: the reply is held, not pushed (`echo_cap`, `relax_rate`) | 126 / 13 |
| axis 1 | orange | GLU | SPAN | excitatory drive: how far the reply reaches and how much it carries (`pool_size`, `hops`) | 71 / 17 |
| axis 1 | yellow | GABA | WRAP | brake and noise filter: encloses the reply, prunes loops and heat (`prune_floor`, `echo_cap`) | 154 / 21 |
| axis 2 | green | DA | HOOK | SEEKING: curiosity and novelty; catches interest, marks progress (`novelty_rank`) | 192 / 27 |
| axis 2 | blue | 5HT | ELABORATE | patience, coping, inhibition; stretches a reply over several steps without breaking (`coherence`) | 331 / 23 |
| axis 3 | indigo | NE | SCAFFOLD | gain on attention and urgency; temporary structure that narrows the frame (`short_frame`) | 55 / 20 |
| axis 3 | violet | OXT | ANCHOR | social alignment: anchors the reply to the user and their words (`user_boost`); also raises in-group bias, so it is paired with NE | 66 / 14 |

The silk names are the orbweaver slot names (`ANCHOR SPAN SCAFFOLD ELABORATE HOOK WRAP SHELL`). The chemical sets the knob; the silk says which job that knob does in the reply. The pairs on one axis oppose each other in the sources: GLU against GABA (excite against inhibit), DA against 5HT (approach and impulse against patience and restraint), NE against OXT (alarm against social safety: CRH drives the locus coeruleus, oxytocin and opioids quiet GRIEF). The hub, OPI, is the recovery chemistry.

**Why OPI and not CB1.** The Gemini hub was CB1. Across the 40 papers CB1 has 23 emotion-linked sentences in 7 papers; the opioid system has 126 in 13, and Panksepp names opioids as inhibitors of both RAGE and GRIEF. CB1 stays on the reserve list below and is retested if the fit asks for it.

Baseline (the pure hue): OPI 0.50, GLU 0.45, GABA 0.65, DA 0.50, 5HT 0.75, NE 0.30, OXT 0.50.

|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| puppy-love laugh | mean of ATTACHMENT + PLAY | 0.80 | 0.60 | 0.50 | 0.82 | 0.65 | 0.45 | 0.82 |
| angry laugh | mean of RAGE + PLAY | 0.45 | 0.75 | 0.30 | 0.75 | 0.35 | 0.70 | 0.45 |
| crazy laugh | mean of MANIA + PLAY | 0.65 | 0.70 | 0.40 | 0.88 | 0.45 | 0.57 | 0.50 |
| cynical laugh | mean of CYNICAL + PASSE | 0.40 | 0.40 | 0.55 | 0.25 | 0.45 | 0.33 | 0.22 |

**Sarcasm** is a pair, not a point: the words read as one recipe (CONTENTMENT-like) while the situation reads as another (CYNICAL, OVERWHELMED). The detector is the distance between the word reading and the situation reading; a Tone character holds one reading, so an utterance carries two.

## 3. Cancellation table (the dispenser)

Conjugate = RECEPTIVE minus 0.6 times the user's deviation from RECEPTIVE, per axis, clamped to 0..1, applied only when the user is farther than 0.5 from RECEPTIVE (a noise gate: states already near it are held). It inverts the disturbance and leaves the information channel open; the gain is below 1 so it cannot overshoot into forced cheer. The last column names the nearest dispensation.

Version 2 (above) centres on RECEPTIVE with the dead-band: every cancelled state ends about 40% closer to RECEPTIVE (RAGE 1.09 to 0.62, PANICKED 1.29 to 0.72, DESPAIR 1.13 to 0.64) and SEEKING, PLAY, VIBRANT, CONTENTMENT are held. Next test: run the loop with real reactions (USER SELF) and tune k and the band.

## 4. Meet, then lead (Pascal)

Pascal (The Art of Persuasion): two doors lead into a person, the understanding and the will; most things enter by the will, and a thing persuades with certainty when it joins admitted truths to what the heart loves. So the dispenser starts at the user's own mix (step 0, agree with the true part of what they said), then moves linearly to the target over N turns (`meet_then_lead`), reading the user's reaction from the USER SELF between steps. The target is RECEPTIVE for information intake.

## 5. The serious-news procedure (Rusinova 2026)

For OVERWHELMED and PANICKED the sources fix an order of reply, not only a mix: (1) the first statement short, clear and direct, because stress narrows attention; (2) a deliberate pause, then name the emotion; (3) safety before detail: SETTLE until the user's messages lengthen; (4) repeat the key point in simple words and ask the user to say what they are taking from it, because memory under stress is fragile; (5) empathic response throughout, to restore the ability to encode. The recipe is SETTLE during 1 to 3, then FOCUS, then GUIDE.

## 6. The receptive recipe

RECEPTIVE: OPI 0.60, GLU 0.75, GABA 0.70, DA 0.70, 5HT 0.65, NE 0.50, OXT 0.50. NE sits mid-range (phasic gain, not tonic), DA keeps the curiosity, GABA and OPI keep the container, 5HT keeps patience.

## 7. Reserve list (retest if the fit asks)

| chemical | emotion-linked sentences / papers | role | why not in the seven |
|---|---|---|---|
| ACh | 44 / 10 | attention precision and encoding (Feldman & Friston 2010 in the corpus) | strongest candidate to replace 5HT or NE if attention fitting needs its own axis |
| CRF / cortisol | 83 / 14 and 133 / 23 | the stress readout upstream of NE (CRH drives the locus coeruleus); cortisol impairs encoding (Rusinova) | folded into NE and GLU high with GABA and OPI low; kept as a readout, not a dial |
| CB1 | 23 / 7 | retrograde brake, extinction of aversive learning | thin in the corpus; the Gemini hub |
| vasopressin | 17 / 11 | assertiveness, jealousy (Panksepp) | paired with OXT in the sources; add if male-typical assertion needs its own recipe |
| substance P, NPY | 5 / 3 and 33 / 6 | RAGE arousal; FEAR regulation | peptide co-factors of GLU and GABA in the primary systems |
